# GetHired

> GetHired is a job board at gethired.devhub.co.in where job seekers can browse current job openings. It focuses on developer and tech roles from startups and companies.

## Main pages

- [Browse jobs](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/jobs): Current job listings, searchable by role, skill, and location
- [Hire candidates](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire): Page for recuirters who want to hire candidates suiting their needs.
- [About](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/about): What GetHired is and who runs it
- [Contact](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/contact): How to reach the team for support or partnerships

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/privacy): How user data and cookies are handled
- [Terms of use](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/terms): Rules for job seekers and employers

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/sitemap/0.xml): Full list of pages on the site
